name: Block Responsive – Responsive Controls for Editor Blocks
author: Sheikh Ashrafuzzman

sections.description:
Block Responsive is a powerful WordPress plugin that adds comprehensive responsive controls to Gutenberg blocks. It allows you to control the visibility and styling of blocks based on different screen sizes (mobile, tablet, and desktop).

Key Features

📱 Display Controls

– Hide/show blocks on specific devices (mobile, tablet, desktop)
– Simple toggle controls with device-specific icons
– Visual feedback for hidden blocks

🎨 Responsive Styling Options

– Typography Controls: Font size, line height, letter spacing, and text alignment for each device
– Colors Controls: Text color, background color, and border color with device-specific settings
– Dimensions Controls: Padding, margin, width, and height controls for responsive layouts
– Alignment Controls: Block alignment settings for different screen sizes
– Background Image Controls: Responsive background image settings
– Border & Shadow Controls: Border radius, border width, and shadow effects per device

🔧 Technical Features

– Works with all core Gutenberg blocks
– Clean, intuitive interface in the block inspector
– Generates optimized CSS for frontend display
– Compatible with WordPress 6.7+
– Built with modern WordPress development standards

Perfect For

– Web Developers who need precise control over responsive layouts
– Content Creators who want to optimize content for different devices
– Designers who need device-specific styling capabilities
– Agencies building responsive WordPress websites

How It Works

  1. Block Inspector Integration: Responsive controls appear in the block inspector panel
  2. Device-Specific Settings: Configure different styles for mobile, tablet, and desktop
  3. Real-time Preview: See changes immediately in the editor
  4. Frontend Rendering: Automatically generates and applies responsive CSS
sections.installation:
Method 1: WordPress Admin (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Block Responsive”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
sections.faq:
How do I access the responsive controls?

After activating the plugin, open any post or page in the Gutenberg editor. Select any block and look for the “Block Responsive” panel in the block inspector (right sidebar). You’ll see various responsive controls organized by category.

Which blocks support responsive controls?

The plugin works with all core Gutenberg blocks (blocks that start with “core/”). This includes paragraphs, headings, images, buttons, columns, and many more.

Can I use this with custom blocks?

Currently, the plugin is designed to work with core WordPress blocks. Custom blocks may not have the responsive controls unless they follow the same structure as core blocks.

Does this affect my existing content?

No, the plugin only adds controls to blocks. It doesn’t modify existing content unless you specifically use the responsive controls on blocks.

Is there a performance impact?

The plugin is optimized for performance. It only loads the necessary scripts and styles in the editor and generates minimal CSS for the frontend.

Can I disable responsive controls for specific blocks?

Currently, all core blocks will have the responsive controls available. Future versions may include options to disable controls for specific blocks.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your content will remain intact, but any responsive styling applied through the plugin will no longer be visible. The blocks will display with their default styling.
